Notice | Massachusetts Cannabis Control Commission Public Health and Safety Advisory: Potentially Contaminated Marijuana Products (sold between September 18, 2024, and January 30, 2025) | February 3, 2025

Samples of the affected products were found to have the presence of yeast and mold above the acceptable testing limits established for Total Yeast and Mold and coliforms.

Consumers that possess any of the affected products may destroy them or return them to the licensee where they were purchased.
